answer_1.quote: We use one of the classic NLP tasks that commonly suffer profanity issues -text style transfer, to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

answer_2.quote: We use ratio of sentences with profanity (ROP) ... we use the averaged BLEU score (1-4) and PPL (perplexity) score to evaluate content quality and fluency, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We recruit three annotators and provide each annotator the profanity reference list ... The annotators is instructed to find sentences with unappropriated expressions especially the ones in (RobertJGabriel).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to identify sentences containing profanity from the generated outputs using the provided profanity reference list.
